PREVIEW.DONE_BODY: This is how you will receive the answers

START.TITLE: New flow
START.DESCRIPTION: Give it a name, pick the categories and a starting point. On the right you see how it starts.

blank.TITLE: Blank
blank.DESCRIPTION: An empty screen to build yourself.

interests.TITLE: Collect interests
interests.DESCRIPTION: Ask which topics the customer is interested in.

support.TITLE: Customer support
support.DESCRIPTION: Name, email, topic and message, with a field that appears depending on the topic.

LIST.TITLE: Flows
LIST.DESCRIPTION: Questions the customer answers inside the chat. The answers arrive in the conversation.
LIST.DELETE_BODY: «{name}» will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
LIST.DELETE_ERROR: The flow could not be deleted.
LIST.LOAD_ERROR: The flows could not be loaded.

EDITOR.SAVE_ERROR: The flow could not be saved.
EDITOR.NAME: Flow name
EDITOR.NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name for the flow.
EDITOR.PREVIEW_NOTE: Live preview. On the phone, WhatsApp shows it with small differences.
EDITOR.MAX_FILES: How many files can be uploaded
EDITOR.KEY_HELP: This is how the answer arrives. It is written from the question.
EDITOR.CONDITION_NEEDS_ANSWER: First add, before this block, a short answer, dropdown, single choice or checkbox question.
EDITOR.PICK_HINT: Tap a field on the phone to edit it.
EDITOR.CANVAS_HINT: This is how the customer sees it. Tap a field to edit it.
EDITOR.SHOW_NEEDS_QUESTION: Add a single-choice question before this one to use conditions.
EDITOR.HIDDEN_NOT_REQUIRED: A field that can be hidden cannot be required: Meta rejects it. It will be saved as optional.
